snippet.title: Debug and Incoming Demo
snippet.description:
Demo, early access? Whats the difference?
I'm optimizing the game for SteamDeck and controller atm.
Ive sealed off an area that will become the Demo-Area where you can take on some SideQuests, Plant Croms, build stuff get to know the game etc.
As time goes on I will update the Demo/Early access with animals and more NPCs. This is great as I can get feedback as the game is being made.
